title: Plural genitive: retained vowel + -jen
summary: Keep the final o, u, ö or y and add -jen in these short words: talo (“house”) → talojen.
objectives: Keep the final o, u, ö or y and add -jen in these short words: talo (“house”) → talojen.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A plural genitive refers to more than one person or thing. Its ending belongs to the plural modifier, not necessarily to the thing owned. Here the task is forming the word.
Keep the final o, u, ö or y and add -jen in these short words. These are plural forms even though their last letter is n.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Keep talo and add -jen: talo + jen = talojen.
